# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and reliability refresh**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates platform integrations and corrects native and managed reliability issues. The unreleased line refreshes the bundled Skia engine, modernizes its supported platform toolchains, and reduces allocations in image and text processing.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Bundled Skia m156 fixes refreshed** — Brings the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes into the native renderer used by SkiaSharp applications. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))

## Bug Fixes

- **String conversion and validation made safe** — Corrects Unicode validation and prevents native buffer over-reads when creating strings and SKData from C strings. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Boolean callback marshalling corrected** — Uses ABI-compatible Boolean and HarfBuzz Boolean representations for managed callback delegates. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Android texture updates synchronized with display refresh** — Improves the timing of Android texture rendering to avoid visible presentation problems. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered stream lifetime fixed** — Corrects retention behavior for front-buffered streams so their backing resources remain available when needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies reduced** — Optimizes managed image pixel copying to reduce overhead when transferring pixel data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text processing allocations reduced** — Avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocations and pools UTF-32 encoding buffers used during HarfBuzz text processing. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))

## Platform

- **Uno WinUI support updated for Uno Platform 7** — Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7 for compatibility with the current Uno release. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Apple and Windows native support modernized** — Raises Apple deployment minimums and aligns Windows native dependencies with supported MAUI releases and the current Windows toolchain. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420))
- **Browser and Linux native assets made more self-contained** — Ships the WebGPU implementation in the static native library and resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5366](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5366))
